mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.0% is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units indicates weak residential demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
